prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: widescreen background environment for an original sci-fi frontier action slot game, Bounty Breakers.
Primary request: Generate one 1536x1024 landscape illustration of a cel-shaded futuristic frontier outpost at dusk.
Scene/backdrop: chunky rust-red industrial buildings framing only the left and right edges, cyan neon signs with abstract luminous shapes at the edges, burnt-orange horizon, foreground near-black pavement.
Composition/framing: wide camera. Keep a very large dark uncluttered central region suitable for overlaying a reel grid, extending across the central 65 percent of the canvas and most of its height. The buildings and detail form a striking edge frame. Dark empty foreground, distant orange sunset peeking behind.
Style/medium: sharp graphic ink lines, thick confident outlines, flat angular cel shading, polished high-quality video-game concept art.
Color palette: burnt orange, rust red, deep navy-black, electric cyan accents.
Constraints: original art; no lettering anywhere, no logos, no reels, no UI, no people, no extra foreground objects. Not photorealistic, not pixel art. Output a single image.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exact ten-icon sprite sheet for original sci-fi frontier action slot game Bounty Breakers.
Primary request: Generate ONE 1536x1024 landscape sprite sheet with an invisible uniform FIVE COLUMN by TWO ROW layout. Exactly TEN icons total, one icon per equal rectangular cell.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat near-black #101923 background across entire image. No grid lines or cell borders.
Composition/framing: center every icon in its own equal cell with ample padding on all four sides. Every icon wholly inside its cell. Never overlap or touch adjacent cells. Icons at similar visual scale and weight, readable at small size.
EXACT top row left to right (five icons): (1) futuristic orange gunslinger helmet; (2) chunky cyan sci-fi revolver; (3) crimson energy blade; (4) gold-and-cyan bounty data chip; (5) bold orange emblem reading exactly "VS".
EXACT bottom row left to right (five icons): (6) chunky stylized letter "A" in cyan; (7) chunky stylized letter "K" in orange; (8) chunky stylized letter "Q" in pale lavender; (9) chunky stylized letter "J" in teal; (10) luminous cyan portal/bonus energy core.
Style/medium: coherent inventory loot item style, sharp graphic ink lines, thick black outlines, chunky angular cel shading, polished original sci-fi action-game art, front or three-quarter view.
Constraints: precisely five icons per row and two rows. No labels or text outside the five explicitly requested letter icons. No extra items, no containers or pedestals, no frames, no grids, no logos. Not photorealistic, not pixel art. Output a single image.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: paired vertical wild character portraits for original sci-fi frontier action slot game Bounty Breakers.
Primary request: Generate ONE 1536x1024 landscape illustration divided compositionally into TWO EQUAL VERTICAL portrait panels side-by-side, each exactly half the canvas width.
Left panel: one original human bounty hunter in an orange armored coat, futuristic respirator, dark spiky hair; shown torso up facing RIGHT, holding a chunky sci-fi pistol aimed toward center. Powerful silhouette.
Right panel: one rival robotic outlaw in a cyan armored coat, sharp angular metal face; shown torso up facing LEFT, holding a chunky sci-fi pistol aimed toward center. Powerful silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: both panels have a clean dark near-black background, no scenery. Separate clean centered figures inside their respective half. Neither figure nor pistol crosses the center split. Keep heads fully visible with top padding; bottom bodies crop naturally at canvas edge.
Style/medium: sharp graphic ink lines, thick black outlines, angular cel shading, polished high-quality action-game character art, strong orange/cyan contrast and dramatic edge lighting.
Constraints: each portrait must be usable independently when cropped down the exact center. Original characters only, no existing intellectual property characters. No text, no logos, no panel titles, no decorative border, no additional characters, no UI. Not photorealistic, not pixel art. Output a single image.
